# Retrieve the latest hotel and restaurant search results from cache
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")
restaurants = get_results_from_cache(key="restaurants")

# Filter hotels for budget $65 per night
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, budget=65)

# Filter restaurants for rating >= 3.5 and budget $50
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(prior_results=restaurants, rating=[3.5, 5.0], budget=50)

# Find the nearest restaurant to the hotel
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, restaurants=filtered_restaurants, groupBy="restaurant")

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Save the filtered restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Save the nearest restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_restaurants", value=nearest_restaurants)

# Output summary to user
print("Here are the filtered hotel options within your budget of $65 per night:")
for hotel in filtered_hotels.search_results:
    print(f"- {hotel['name']} ({hotel['rating']} stars) - ${hotel['price_per_night']} per night")

print("\nHere are the top-rated Norwegian restaurants within your budget of $50:")
for restaurant in filtered_restaurants.search_results:
    print(f"- {restaurant['name']} (Rating: {restaurant['rating']}) - ${restaurant['price_per_person']} per person")

print("\nNearby Norwegian restaurants to your hotel:")
for restaurant in nearest_restaurants.search_results:
    print(f"- {restaurant['name']} ({restaurant['distance']} miles from hotel)")
